stemMd: Entry requires both a ticket and identification. Ira has no identification. Which conclusion is justified?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Ira meets the requirements if a ticket is present.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Ira does not meet the entry requirements.

explanationMd: Because identification is necessary and absent, the conjunction of entry requirements fails regardless of whether Ira has a ticket.

distractorRationale.c: It is only one of two requirements.
distractorRationale.b: Lacking identification says nothing about tickets.
